notes: nowhere-go/testdata/vectors/nw3 is the module-local nw3 conformance corpus
vectors.json is a provenance-annotated export of Nowhere/src/tests/protocol/vectors.json at the pinned commit; the upstream blob is byte-identical modulo the four provenance keys
morph.json is derived from the wire contract: upstream ships no fixed Morph vectors, so these are computed with the documented HMAC-SHA256 schedule and pinned here
UPSTREAM.lock vector_tree_sha256 is sha256-tree-v1 over this directory, mirroring UPSTREAM-nw2.lock over testdata/vectors
complete wire hex tables must not be maintained by hand
nw3 auth salt is SHA-256("nowhere/nw3/auth-root"); role_key = HMAC(HMAC(salt, shared_key_text), role_info || 0x01); tag = HMAC-SHA256(role_key, transport || exporter)[0:16]
FlowStart is one byte: bit 0 selects TCP (0) or UDP (1); senders MUST zero bits 1-7 and receivers MUST ignore them
UDP flow id is (quic_stream_id >> 2) + 1 after direction checks, in [1, 2^30-1]
setup result is a single byte (0..4); registration result is a single byte (0..1)

Morph TCP bootstrap is prelude[64] || nonce[12] with fade (default), full8 or low7 sender policy. Nowhere 3.1 authenticates a Vector identity and counter in the low 7 bits of the tail. A Portal accepts one fresh counter when the tag matches, and still accepts a tag mismatch on the 3.0 path without consulting the replay registry. That fallback is transitional.
fade samples A in [8,12] and B in [16,32], writes printable ASCII on [0,A), low7 on [A,B), full8 on [B,64), using rejection sampling to avoid modulo bias
